definitions.explanation: A collective reference to many different things, implying a wide range of items, factors, or matters.

examples.japanese: {諸々|もろもろ}の{事情|じじょう}がある。
{諸々|もろもろ}の{費用|ひよう}を{含|ふく}めると、{結構|けっこう}な{金額|きんがく}になる。
examples.english: When you include all the various costs, it comes to a considerable amount.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{際|さい}には、{住所|じゅうしょ}{変更|へんこう}の{届|とど}け{出|で}など{諸々|もろもろ}の{手続|てつづ}きが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: When moving, various procedures such as address change notifications are required.

notes:
{諸々|もろもろ} means "various" or "all sorts of." It has a slightly formal or mature tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {諸々|もろもろ}の + noun (various [things])
- {諸々|もろもろ} as a standalone noun meaning "various things"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸々|もろもろ}の{事情|じじょう} (various circumstances)
- {諸々|もろもろ}の{費用|ひよう} (various expenses)
- {諸々|もろもろ}の{手続|てつづ}き (various procedures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {諸々|もろもろ} vs {色々|いろいろ}: Both mean "various," but {諸々|もろもろ} is more formal and often used in written or business contexts, while {色々|いろいろ} is more conversational and widely used in everyday speech.
